market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil-Iran binary and bond yield spike create whipsaw. S&P 500 range-bound as Big Tech supports offset yield pressure. Hormuz reopening hopes vs. fresh threats create daily reversals. Dollar strength persists. Expect 3-5% volatility in energy and rate-sensitive sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI infrastructure capex cycle broadens (optics, networking, sovereign AI). Defense spending structural. China trade normalization supports EM. However, 5% yield world caps equity multiples; consumer weakness persists. Favor quality, pricing power, and AI infrastructure over broad market beta.
